title: One word, two readings
note: jya to jiba to jayb to sinus: the word sine is a misreading, kept.

beats.text: The word sine is a mistake

beats.call: In India it was called jya
beats.callsub: the name for a line across a circle
the sound only, not the meaning

beats.call: So on the page it is j and b
beats.callsub: and jiba looks just like jayb

beats.call: Jayb means a fold, or a pocket
beats.callsub: the Latin translator read it that way

beats.text: In Latin a fold is sinus
beats.sub: and English cut sinus down to sine

beats.text: The maths is Indian. The name is a slip.
